title: Husn-e-Kainat
author: Saim Chishti
description: Husn-e-Kainat ek naatia majmua hai jisme Huzoor Akram ﷺ ki shaan mein naat, salam aur manqabat shamil hain.

title: Shahdaye Karbala
author: Saim Chishti
description: Shahdaye Karbala ek manqabati majmua hai jo Karbala ke shahidon aur Ahle Bait Athar ki shaan mein likha gaya hai.

title: Shaheed Ibn-e-Shaheed
author: Allama Misbah Hussaini
description: Shaheed Ibn-e-Shaheed waqia-e-Karbala aur shahadat ke mauzu par mabni ek aham kitab hai.
